# Amplification Awareness

Small mistakes become large incidents when they cross trust boundaries or automation loops.

## Sensitive choke points

Pay extra care before bulk sends, permission grants, deletes, and irreversible migrations.

## Guardrails

Prefer dry runs or scoped pilots when impact scales superlinearly with input size.

## Stop-the-line triggers

Halt when you detect duplicated conflicting actions or ambiguous authority for a destructive step.
